changes: Manage Servers: fixed a DataTables console warning ("Requested unknown parameter 14") on the cluster-nodes table — a stale column target left over from the servers/cluster unification.

Manage Servers: the rolling-update progress card no longer stays on screen for good. A run that finished before the page was opened is no longer re-shown on every load; the card appears only while a rolling update is running or being watched to its result.

Redis resilience: the reseller API's "kill connection" action and the signals daemon no longer fail hard (a 500, or a daemon crash) when Redis is briefly unreachable — they skip or fail gracefully, as the rest of the panel already does during a short Redis outage.
